query:
WITH latest_population AS (
    SELECT id, age
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
    WHERE snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
      AND is_in_population = TRUE
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT lp.id, lp.age, hl.region
    FROM latest_population lp
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON lp.id = hl.id
    WHERE hl.region IN ('منطقة الباحة', 'منطقة الجوف', 'منطقة الرياض', 'منطقة تبوك', 'منطقة جازان', 'منطقة مكة المكرمة', 'منطقة نجران')
      AND TRIM(hl.region) != '' AND hl.region IS NOT NULL
),
input AS (
    SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS average_age
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY region
    ORDER BY average_age DESC
)
SELECT input.*, poly.wkt FROM input JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Regions_Polygons poly ON input.region = poly.region
